note: Stable asset ids -> image files. status: real = genuine third-party artwork with a verified licence and a credit record (see docs/ART_ASSETS.md); placeholder = labelled stand-in PNG, NOT final art; needed = no file yet. The 'fit' note says how closely a real asset matches its brief.

env.warehouse.wide_dark.alt: Wide view down a dark warehouse aisle after the power fails.
env.warehouse.wide_dark.brief: Wide cinematic ink-and-wash illustration: tall racking receding in perspective, strip lights dead, a few torch beams and distant silhouettes of staff, emergency amber glow at the far end, cold navy shadows, concrete floor with wet reflections.
env.warehouse.wide_dark.fit: Closest match. A real black-and-white photograph of a large empty industrial hall with overhead strip lights, not racking and not an ink illustration. Cropped to 16:9 and resized.

credit.author: Kari Hakli
credit.changes: Cropped and resized to 1600x900; converted to PNG.
credit.evidence: Commons file page carries {{cc-by-4.0}}; source recorded as a Finnish Heritage Agency (Finna) record, author Kari Hakli.

env.warehouse.aisle_depth.alt: Out-of-focus warehouse aisle used behind close-ups.
env.warehouse.aisle_depth.brief: Same warehouse as the wide shot from a lower, closer angle, racking and boxes softly out of focus, one torch beam crossing the frame, heavy shadow on the left.
env.warehouse.aisle_depth.fit: Close match in content (tall racking aisle with pallets). A colour photograph, not an ink illustration. Cropped to 16:9 and resized; no brand names visible.

credit.title: Interior of an Warehouses.jpg
credit.author: Encik Tekateki
credit.changes: Cropped and resized to 1600x900; converted to PNG.

env.control_room.terminals.alt: Control room terminals after the system failure.
env.control_room.terminals.brief: Bank of terminals and monitors, most black or showing frozen error screens, one with scrolling login records, steel-blue light on desks, a red status LED, cables and chairs left in a hurry.
env.control_room.terminals.fit: Partial match. A real control room with a wall of monitors and operator desks, but bright and working, not failed or dark. A photograph. Cropped to 16:9 and resized.

credit.title: Control room of BESSY II, 2025-06-28.jpeg
credit.author: Nylki
credit.changes: Cropped and resized to 1600x900; converted to PNG.
credit.evidence: Commons file page carries {{cc0}}; {{own}} work of the uploader Nylki.

env.ops_office.night.alt: Operations office at night, used behind the reaction shot.
env.ops_office.night.brief: Operations office after midnight, rain on the window, whiteboard of the shipment timeline, one desk lamp, laptop glow; soft focus so a character can stand in front.
env.ops_office.night.fit: Partial match. An empty open-plan office with lights on; there is no rain, whiteboard or desk lamp. A photograph. Cropped to 16:9 and resized.

env.ops_office.decision.alt: Wide dim backdrop behind the decision panel.
env.ops_office.decision.brief: Very wide, low-contrast version of the operations office, mostly dark navy, leaving the centre quiet for text.
env.ops_office.decision.fit: Partial match. A dim, empty open-plan office, cropped to a wide strip. A photograph.

fg.terminal.failed_evidence.alt: Close-up of a failed terminal showing suspicious logins.
fg.terminal.failed_evidence.brief: Transparent PNG, tight on a monitor: frozen scanner software, a dead inventory dashboard and a list of login records with one entry highlighted. No readable story text; abstract lines only. Fingerprints on the glass, reflection of a face.
fg.terminal.failed_evidence.fit: Good match for a failed terminal. A real photo of a crashed Windows stop screen on a public terminal, cropped to the error text. Opaque photo rather than a transparent cut-out, so it appears as a framed insert.

env.arjun.hands_keyboard.alt: Hands typing at a laptop in front of a second screen.
env.arjun.hands_keyboard.brief: Stand-in for Arjun working at the failed system, shown without a face: hands on a keyboard, screens glowing.
env.arjun.hands_keyboard.fit: Stand-in photograph of an unnamed person's hands, not Arjun. It shows hands and a laptop only; the screen is not a failed system. Cropped to 1600x860.

env.director.skyline_silhouette.alt: A person seen only as a dark silhouette from behind, looking out of a tall office window at a city skyline.
env.director.skyline_silhouette.brief: Stand-in for the Operations Director's reaction, shown without a face or any identifying features: a silhouette against a window.
env.director.skyline_silhouette.fit: Stand-in photograph of an unnamed person, not the director. A pure silhouette seen from behind, so no face, gender or clothing is shown. It is lit as dusk or daytime, while the story is set at night. Cropped to 1600x667.
